Controls & shortcuts

Start Retime in either editor’s header or sidebar. Double-click to add markers, then drag.

ControlAction
Double-click / Ctrl+ClickAdd marker
Drag markerWarp timing
Drag span barMove the segment
Drag blue diamondShift motion’s halfway point
Drag blue handlesEase or fast start / end
Drag green barResize smooth zone
SAuto-smooth all markers
IInsert keys at selected markers; all if none
X / DeleteDelete selected markers
Shift+ClickMulti-select markers
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+ZUndo / redo retime drags and inserted keys
Release drag, then EnterKeep changes and exit as one Blender undo step
EscRestore starting animation and exit
Right-click during dragCancel only that drag

Session markers disappear on exit. View navigation and the time-scrub strip remain available.

Install & start

Requires Blender 5.2+. Drag the downloaded extension ZIP into Blender and confirm installation. Keep the ZIP as downloaded.

Use the Retime button in the Graph Editor or Dope Sheet header, or the sidebar tab. Current version: 2.4.2.

Which keys change?

All keys on included editable, unlocked curves change, even when the keys are not selected. Use editor visibility filters or Selected Curves Only to choose the scope.

One marker shifts them all. Outside smooth zones, keys beyond the outer markers follow the nearest outer marker’s offset; stationary outer markers leave those keys stationary.

Keys can land on subframes. Snap Markers on Frame snaps markers, not keys. A marker already on a subframe can retain its fractional offset when snapping is enabled.

Smoothing & ease limits

Smoothing changes nearby key timing while marker guides stay fixed. Wide zones and big speed changes can shift keys by more than one frame.

Each completed retime becomes the latest live smoothing target. Undo, redo, or insertion of new keys clears that target; saved zones then apply to the next retime. After adding or deleting markers, complete another retime before adjusting zones.

Each ease handle affects only its own half of a span. Handles need about 60 screen pixels of span width. Ease controls reset to neutral on release; the timing change stays baked.
